data.summary: This week Ethan Qiu made 37 GitHub contributions across several public repositories, with the most activity in UTMIST/Misty, Jeff15321/mathify-brief, and UTMIST/UTMIST. He also opened issues in UTMIST/Misty (#357, #358, #359, #360, #361, #362, #383, #384) and UTMIST/UTMIST (#504, #506).
